design.foundation: existing Dark Deco native CSS and JavaScript
design.palette: existing TAS tokens; paper background and dark red accent

features: nine independent storyboard panels, shuffled on fresh entry
desktop drag swaps; click/tap pairs; arrow keys and native keyboard activation
single-shot hint and selected-panel image dialog
ordered completion cue respecting reduced motion and site motion toggle
video attached only after a completed puzzle and explicit play
player overlays the exact nine-cell rectangle; covered tiles are inert and disabled
close video pauses playback and restores the solved board and opener focus
new round pauses and clears video, hides overlay and reshuffles

browser.desktopDrag: native drag swapped two cells and cleared drag styles
browser.clickAndKeyboard: click pairs swap; arrows move focus; Escape closes image dialog and restores focus
browser.rootVideo: readyState 4 and paused false after explicit play
browser.overlay: grid and player bounds match at 1280px, 390px and 320px
browser.coveredControls: all nine tile buttons disabled, grid aria-hidden true while overlay is visible
browser.close: pauses video, leaves nine ordered panels, restores play-button focus
browser.reset: removes video src, pauses, hides player and reshuffles
browser.motion: reduced motion and site still mode tested in regression harness

preservation.video: unchanged source bytes; original watermark retained
